title: Mixed conditionals in past, present and future - Complex time relationships

options.answer: If she had studied medicine, she would work in a hospital now.
If she had studied medicine, she would be working in a hospital now.
If she studied medicine, she would have worked in a hospital now.

explanation.en: This is a mixed conditional combining past condition with present result. The correct form uses 'would be working' to show an ongoing present situation resulting from a past action.
explanation.ru: Это смешанное условное предложение, объединяющее прошлое условие с настоящим результатом. Правильная форма использует 'would be working', чтобы показать продолжающуюся настоящую ситуацию, являющуюся результатом прошлого действия.
explanation.uz: Bu o'tmishdagi shartni hozirgi natija bilan birlashtirgan aralash shartli gap. To'g'ri shakl 'would be working' dan foydalanadi, bu o'tmishdagi harakatdan kelib chiqqan davom etayotgan hozirgi vaziyatni ko'rsatadi.

question.en: Which sentence correctly expresses a present condition with a past result?
question.ru: Какое предложение правильно выражает настоящее условие с прошлым результатом?
question.uz: Qaysi gap hozirgi shartni o'tmishdagi natija bilan to'g'ri ifodalaydi?

options.answer: If I was rich, I would have bought that house last year.
If I were rich, I would have bought that house last year.
If I am rich, I would have bought that house last year.

explanation.en: Mixed conditionals with present condition and past result require 'were' in the if-clause and 'would have + past participle' in the main clause.
explanation.ru: Смешанные условные предложения с настоящим условием и прошлым результатом требуют 'were' в условной части и 'would have + причастие прошедшего времени' в главной части.
explanation.uz: Hozirgi shart va o'tmishdagi natijali aralash shartli gaplarda if-qismida 'were' va asosiy qismida 'would have + o'tmish sifatdoshi' talab qilinadi.

question.en: Choose the grammatically correct mixed conditional.
question.ru: Выберите грамматически правильное смешанное условное предложение.
question.uz: Grammatik jihatdan to'g'ri aralash shartli gapni tanlang.

options.answer: If you had left earlier, you wouldn't be stuck in traffic now.
If you left earlier, you wouldn't have been stuck in traffic now.
If you have left earlier, you wouldn't be stuck in traffic now.

explanation.en: This mixed conditional correctly combines past perfect in the if-clause with conditional present in the main clause to show how a past action affects the present situation.
explanation.ru: Это смешанное условное предложение правильно объединяет past perfect в условной части с условным настоящим в главной части, чтобы показать, как прошлое действие влияет на настоящую ситуацию.
explanation.uz: Bu aralash shartli gap if-qismida past perfect ni asosiy qismida shartli hozirgi zamon bilan to'g'ri birlashtiradi, bu o'tmishdagi harakat hozirgi vaziyatga qanday ta'sir qilishini ko'rsatadi.

question.en: Which sentence shows the correct form of a mixed conditional with future implication?
question.ru: Какое предложение показывает правильную форму смешанного условного предложения с будущим подтекстом?
question.uz: Qaysi gap kelajakka ishora qiluvchi aralash shartli gapning to'g'ri shaklini ko'rsatadi?

options.answer: If I had taken that job, I will be living in Paris next year.
If I had taken that job, I would be living in Paris next year.
If I took that job, I would have been living in Paris next year.

explanation.en: Mixed conditionals expressing future consequences of past actions use 'would be + -ing' to show continuing future states.
explanation.ru: Смешанные условные предложения, выражающие будущие последствия прошлых действий, используют 'would be + -ing' для обозначения продолжающихся будущих состояний.
explanation.uz: O'tmishdagi harakatlarning kelajakdagi oqibatlarini ifodalovchi aralash shartli gaplar davom etadigan kelajak holatlarini ko'rsatish uchun 'would be + -ing' dan foydalanadi.

question.en: Select the correct mixed conditional sentence.

options.answer: If she were more organized, she wouldn't missed the deadline yesterday.
If she were more organized, she wouldn't have missed the deadline yesterday.
If she was more organized, she wouldn't miss the deadline yesterday.

explanation.en: This mixed conditional correctly uses present subjunctive 'were' with past perfect result to show how a present characteristic would have affected a past event.
explanation.ru: Это смешанное условное предложение правильно использует настоящее сослагательное наклонение 'were' с результатом в past perfect, чтобы показать, как настоящая характеристика повлияла бы на прошлое событие.
explanation.uz: Bu aralash shartli gap hozirgi xususiyat o'tmishdagi hodisaga qanday ta'sir qilishini ko'rsatish uchun hozirgi soslагательное наклонение 'were' ni past perfect natijasi bilan to'g'ri ishlatadi.

question.en: Which mixed conditional correctly expresses an unreal past condition affecting the present?
question.ru: Какое смешанное условное предложение правильно выражает нереальное прошлое условие, влияющее на настоящее?
question.uz: Qaysi aralash shartli gap hozirgi zamonga ta'sir qiluvchi haqiqiy bo'lmagan o'tmishdagi shartni to'g'ri ifodalaydi?

options.answer: If they had invested wisely, they would have more money now.
If they invested wisely, they would have had more money now.
If they have invested wisely, they would have more money now.

explanation.en: This structure correctly combines past perfect (had invested) with present conditional (would have) to show past actions affecting current situations.
explanation.ru: Эта структура правильно объединяет past perfect (had invested) с настоящим условным (would have), чтобы показать влияние прошлых действий на текущие ситуации.
explanation.uz: Bu struktura o'tmishdagi harakatlarning hozirgi vaziyatlarga ta'sirini ko'rsatish uchun past perfect (had invested) ni hozirgi shartli (would have) bilan to'g'ri birlashtiradi.

options.answer: If I wasn't so tired, I would have finished the project last night.
If I weren't so tired, I would have finished the project last night.
If I am not so tired, I would have finished the project last night.

explanation.en: Mixed conditionals use 'weren't' in present unreal conditions affecting past results, combined with 'would have + past participle'.
explanation.ru: Смешанные условные предложения используют 'weren't' в настоящих нереальных условиях, влияющих на прошлые результаты, в сочетании с 'would have + причастие прошедшего времени'.
explanation.uz: Aralash shartli gaplar o'tmishdagi natijalarga ta'sir qiluvchi hozirgi haqiqiy bo'lmagan shartlarda 'weren't' ni 'would have + o'tmish sifatdoshi' bilan birlashtiradi.

explanation.uz: Bu aralash shartli gap o'tmishdagi harakat (haydashni o'rganish) hozirgi vaziyatga (transportga ehtiyoj) qanday ta'sir qilishini to'g'ri ko'rsatadi.

The gap between academic theory and real-world application continues to widen. If curriculum designers ___11___ more collaborative with industry professionals, educational programs ___12___ be producing graduates who are better prepared for modern careers. explanation.en: This passage uses mixed conditionals to analyze educational systems, showing how past teaching methods affect current student outcomes and how present educational approaches influence future career readiness.
